import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from runner import *

fails = []
def expect(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        fails.append((name, got, want))
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("   got :", json.dumps(got))
        print("   want:", json.dumps(want))
    else:
        print("ok:", name)

def m(**kw):
    base_m = {"host_probe_tx":0,"network_ping_tx":0,"network_ack_tx":0,"host_ack_tx":0,
              "deduplicated_ping":0,"capacity_drops":0,"late_ping":0,"ignored_ack":0,
              "allocations":0,"cache_peak":[],"peak_entries":0,"end_us":0}
    base_m.update(kw)
    return base_m

# ---------- S8: release at deadline+1 frees capacity for a same-time launch ----------
edges = [edge(0,1), edge(1,2)]
d = base(n=3, capacity=[1,3,3], edges=edges,
         rounds=[rnd(launch=0,timeout=10), rnd(launch=11,timeout=10)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("S8.started", [r["started"] for r in res["rounds"]], [True, True])
expect("S8.finals", [(r["source_final_us"], r["host_delivery_us"]) for r in res["rounds"]],
       [(4,5),(15,16)])
expect("S8.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=2, network_ping_tx=4, network_ack_tx=4, host_ack_tx=2,
    allocations=6, cache_peak=[1,2,2], peak_entries=6, end_us=21))
# negative control: launch at 10 (release is at 11) -> capacity drop
d = base(n=3, capacity=[1,3,3], edges=edges,
         rounds=[rnd(launch=0,timeout=10), rnd(launch=10,timeout=10)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("S8b.started", [r["started"] for r in res["rounds"]], [True, False])
expect("S8b.metrics.capdrops", res["metrics"]["capacity_drops"], 1)
expect("S8b.r1", res["rounds"][1], {"id":1,"started":False,"source_final_us":None,
    "source_complete":None,"host_delivery_us":None,"source_proof":[]})

# ---------- S9: same-timestamp PING order by edge key; drop discards parent; late timeout ACK ignored ----------
edges = [edge(0,1,ping=1,label="p"), edge(1,3,ping=5,label="q"), edge(0,2,ping=1,label="r"),
         edge(2,3,ping=5,label="s"), edge(3,4,ping=1,label="t")]
d = base(n=5, capacity=[2,2,2,1,2], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0,timeout=100)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("S9.rounds", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":100,"source_complete":False,
    "host_delivery_us":101,"source_proof":[0,1,4]}])
expect("S9.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, network_ping_tx=5, network_ack_tx=4, host_ack_tx=1,
    capacity_drops=1, ignored_ack=1, allocations=5, cache_peak=[1,1,1,1,1], peak_entries=5, end_us=101))
sigs = {tuple(c["signature"]): c for c in res["classes"]}
expect("S9.class-ab", sigs[("p","q","t")]["evidence_rounds"], [0])
expect("S9.class-rst", sigs[("r","s","t")]["evidence_rounds"], [])
expect("S9.coverage", res["summary"]["coverage_status"], "partial")

# ---------- S12: PING exactly at deadline; its forwarding is late; entry timeout same instant ----------
edges = [edge(0,1,ping=3,ack=1,label="z"), edge(1,2,ping=1,ack=1,label="z")]
d = base(n=3, capacity=[3,3,3], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0,timeout=3,host_delay=1)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("S12.rounds", res["rounds"], [{"id":0,"started":True,"source_final_us":3,"source_complete":False,
    "host_delivery_us":4,"source_proof":[]}])
expect("S12.metrics", res["metrics"], m(host_probe_tx=1, network_ping_tx=2, network_ack_tx=1, host_ack_tx=1,
    late_ping=1, ignored_ack=1, allocations=2, cache_peak=[1,1,0], peak_entries=2, end_us=4))

# ---------- S15: prefix signatures sort first ----------
edges = [edge(0,2,label="a"), edge(0,1,label="a"), edge(1,2,label="a")]
d = base(n=3, capacity=[3,3,3], edges=edges, rounds=[rnd(launch=0,timeout=100)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("S15.order", [c["signature"] for c in res["classes"]], [["a"],["a","a"]])
expect("S15.counts", [c["candidate_count"] for c in res["classes"]], [1,1])
expect("S15.wits", [c["candidate_witnesses"] for c in res["classes"]], [[[0]],[[1,2]]])
expect("S15.summary", res["summary"], {"topology_paths":2,"observable_classes":2,"observed_classes":2,
    "unique_observed_classes":2,"ambiguous_observed_classes":0,"path_evidence_lower":2,
    "path_evidence_upper":2,"coverage_status":"complete"})

# ---------- S16: round array order != time order; evidence_rounds sorted by id ----------
# round 0 launches late, round 1 early, same graph, alias labels
edges = [edge(0,1,label="a"), edge(1,3,label="b"), edge(0,2,label="a"), edge(2,3,label="b")]
d = base(n=4, capacity=[3,3,3,3], edges=edges,
         rounds=[rnd(launch=50,timeout=100), rnd(launch=0,timeout=100)])
res = run_ok(d)
expect("S16.finals", [(r["id"], r["source_final_us"], r["host_delivery_us"]) for r in res["rounds"]],
       [(0,55,56),(1,5,6)])
expect("S16.classes", res["classes"], [{"signature":["a","b"],"candidate_count":2,
    "evidence_rounds":[0,1],"state":"ambiguous","candidate_witnesses":[[0,1],[2,3]]}])
expect("S16.summary", res["summary"], {"topology_paths":2,"observable_classes":1,"observed_classes":1,
    "unique_observed_classes":0,"ambiguous_observed_classes":1,"path_evidence_lower":1,
    "path_evidence_upper":2,"coverage_status":"complete"})

print()
print("FAILURES:", len(fails))
for f in fails: print(f)
